idea: Cheap wrist wearable nudges the user with a single vibration pattern ninety minutes before their historically best bedtime, learned from a week of sleep-tracking data, with no app needed after the initial setup week.
customer: An adult who wants a better bedtime routine but won't keep using an app or logging anything nightly -- they want the device to learn quietly and just nudge them.
pieces: not decomposed -- moved here from problems/ during cleanup: its old pieces were hand-authored by Claude before the 'never predefine the pieces' rule was established. See BRIDGE.md and README.md.
